high_level_description: A centered, full-figure portrait of one woman in a floral sundress and straw hat, bending to hold a garden hose nozzle, with a prominent bright blue curved water arc emerging from it — all on a plain near-white background.

style_description.lighting: Even, soft frontal lighting with no shadows

elements.desc: Woman: light skin tone, straw hat, floral sundress with blue flowers, bending forward, arms extended downward-left
Gray garden hose entering from left edge, curving rightward to meet her hand
Metallic gray hose nozzle held in her right hand
Bright blue curved water arc starting at nozzle tip, peaking high and arcing rightward
